_opis: Runewordi, ki so v S14 novi ali spremenjeni (povzetek S14 Alliance tentative patch notes). Statsi v tooltipih so z wikija pred S14, zato te opombe veljajo pred njimi.

Madness.note: Nov v S14: 4-socket orožje. Ob zadetku proži curse (Lower Resist, Amplify Damage in druge).

Finesse.note: Nov v S14: 3-socket oklep s pierceom, IAS in extra gold.

Deception.note: Nov v S14: 3-socket helm s critical strike chance in multiplierjem.

Jealousy.note: Nov v S14: 3-socket amazon metalno orožje s +12 Split Throw. +3 javelin skills pride iz baze Matriarchal Javelin.

Gloom.note: S14: +1 maksimalni curse, curse resistance 30–40 % (prej 20 %), FHR samo še 20 % (prej 20–40 %), brez »damage taken gained as mana«.

Famine.note: S14: −enemy fire, lightning in cold res je zdaj 15–20 % (prej 10–15 %).

Hand of Justice.note: S14: Holy Fire aura na levelu 14 (prej 12).

Delirium.note: S14: doda +1 Delirium form (oskill; v obliki skillov ne moreš uporabljati), −10 % enemy physical res in ignore target's defense.
